title: Contrapunctus XI

captions.text: ☞ Subject I in the alto: the main subject, broken by rests.
☞ The answer in the soprano, on A.
☞ The answer in the tenor: all four voices are in.
☞ Subject II in the alto: Contrapunctus VIII's first subject, upside down.
☞ Subject I inverted in the tenor.
☞ Subject III in the tenor: a chromatic line rising in repeated notes.
☞ Subject III in the soprano, over subject II in the alto.
☞ Stretto: subject III in the alto, then in the soprano.
☞ All three subjects: III in the alto, II in the soprano, I in the tenor.
☞ Subject I and its inversion at once: the alto, and the soprano upside down.
☞ Subjects II and III together, in the tenor and the bass.
☞ The last entry: subject I in the soprano.

listenFor: the three subjects of VIII upside down, with a chromatic rising line
